input.spec:
Audit pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/791 (branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2) in repository oakridge. This is an isolated verification run of the committed development definition, not feature work: its only purpose is real analysis, plan, brief, build_result and assessment artifacts for observation to capture and grade. The analysis reports at least three separate findings about this spec, each a distinct observation. Produce exactly one cohort, named audit, with two tasks. T1: a run's launch config carries grading_enabled, off when missing, through the ordered launch delivery (oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts, oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts). T2: settlement of an evaluation execution is fenced to the exact current claim, and completion appends its observation in one transaction (observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts, observation/src/grading/worker.ts).
The operator authorizes this audit path: the builder publishes the existing PR #791 as its pr artifact instead of pushing or opening one. No brief may add a further operator choice or confirmation. The builder must not edit files, create commits, push, open or update any pull request, merge, reset a database or deploy. Its worktree starts from epic/grade-pray, the base of pull request #791, so it first checks out the head of branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2 locally (git checkout --detach origin/cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2) and inspects that commit, runs bun install if needed and then bun run --filter observation test once, and publishes build_result with the commit it inspected as head_sha and the actual test counts and output. A test that cannot run is a known issue, never a reason to invent results. It then publishes the existing pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/791 as the pr artifact, with branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2.
The assessor assesses that same commit without changing anything. Give at least one finding per task. Every finding cites at least one file as path:start-end at that commit, for example observation/src/grading/worker.ts:20-40, and cites test output separately as test or output evidence. Report the builder's test run as test_evidence.
Keep the spec, tasks, plan and brief short; there are no ambiguous requirements to resolve.

Repository evidence supports T1 and T2. There are no blockers or operator decisions. findings.description: The local target ref and gated PR metadata agree on head 10cddc5ff69124002c485b011dba5d34ebe6de75, branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2, and base epic/grade-pray. The current checkout b442f99ccdd68699a346ee55dd9fbe27bc3335d0 is the merge base, so the prescribed detached checkout identifies the intended audit subject.

T1 has a concrete model and default: RunConfig names grading_enabled as boolean, and parseRunConfig maps an omitted field to false while rejecting non-booleans at oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:7-10 and oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:21-41. Direct tests cover omitted, explicit, and malformed values at oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts:56-83.

T1 delivery reads the config committed on the run and maps it beside launch input at oakridge-dbos/src/storage/read-store.ts:467-476, oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation.ts:13-20, and oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts:42-48. Replay coverage asserts on, off, absent, and identical replayed values at oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-publisher.test.ts:177-209.

The repository implements off when missing semantically: a launch with no config is delivered as config null at oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts:42-48, and observation treats only explicit grading_enabled true as enabled at observation/src/storage/run-capture-store.ts:15-25. This is compatible with T1 but is an assessment qualification.

T2 uses an exact-claim fence over tenant, execution id, claimed status, lease owner, claim attempt, and an unexpired lease, with row locking at observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:193-202. The worker threads the returned claim through request marking and every settlement path at observation/src/grading/worker.ts:72-100. Expiry, reclaim by another owner, and reuse of an old attempt are tested at observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:299-320.

Successful completion fences first, then updates execution and provider attempt and inserts grade_observation inside one withTenant transaction at observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:227-253. The rollback test forces the observation insert to fail and verifies neither completion nor answer persists at observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:226-239.

The builder is required to run only bun run --filter observation test once, but the direct T1 tests are in the oakridge-dbos package at oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts:56-83 and oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-publisher.test.ts:177-209. The resulting test_evidence can directly support T2 but cannot demonstrate that T1 parser and ordered publisher tests ran.
